Status icon

Source: R/marks.R
bb_status.Rd

A filled circle with a white check (`"yes"`), cross (`"no"`) or dash (`"unknown"`), drawn as vectors in the theme status palette, optionally followed by a label such as "Yes". `TRUE`/`FALSE` map to yes/no; `NA` and anything else to unknown. Use it as a table cell, in columns, or anywhere a block goes.

Usage

bb_status(
  state,
  label = NULL,
  size = 14/96,
  palette = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  gap = 7/96,
  align = c("left", "center", "right"),
  nudge_y = 1.5/96
)

Arguments

state

`"yes"`, `"no"`, `"unknown"`, or a logical.

label

Optional text printed after the icon.

size

Icon diameter (`grid::unit` or inches). Default 14px.

palette

Named colours for yes/no/unknown; defaults to the theme's.

style

Text style of the label ([text_style()] or a role name); defaults to the `status_label` role.

gap

Space between icon and label.

align

Horizontal position in its slot: `"left"`, `"center"`, `"right"`. Inside [bb_table()] the column alignment places it instead.

nudge_y

Upward shift (inches) that lines the icon up optically with neighbouring text (text boxes sit slightly high). Default 1.5px.

Value

A block.

Examples

bb_status("yes", label = "Yes")
#> <bb_status>
bb_status(NA)
#> <bb_status>
